name: Santa Catarina
title: LGBTQ rights in Santa Catarina
extract: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer (LGBTQ) people in the Brazilian state of Santa Catarina enjoy many of the same legal protections available to non-LGBTQ people. Same-sex marriage has been legally performed in the state since April 2013, before national legalization by the Supreme Federal Court. Despite this, according to research by Agência Diadorim, as of 2025, 19 anti-LGBTQ bills had been introduced in the state's Legislative Assembly, with 11 of them being authored by the Liberal Party (PL). Santa Catarina is also considered one of the most conservative states in Brazil.
